top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Superior Morgul Road Race's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
6,000ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.

Road-specific control matters at Superior Morgul Road Race. Practice on paved circuit road race on rolling Front Range: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 56 miles.
56 miles on paved circuit road race on rolling Front Range burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
107ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Superior Morgul Road Race, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Superior Morgul Road Race. Train it until it feels boring.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on paved circuit road race on rolling Front Range can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,000ft of climbing on paved circuit road race on rolling Front Range does to your power file on race day.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Superior Morgul Road Race. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
6,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Base fitness for Superior Morgul Road Race. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Superior Morgul Road Race’s 56 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Superior Morgul Road Race. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, VO2max, and Road Specific to prepare you for 56 miles of paved circuit road race on rolling front range terrain in Superior, Boulder County, Colorado, USA.
